title: pediomelum tenuiflorum
intro: Pediomelum tenuiflorum, commonly known as False Indigo or Rocky Mountain Indigo, is a flowering plant species in the pea family Fabaceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Pediomelum tenuiflorum include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, coumarins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
